name: PotPilot UDP binary packet layout
struct_format_note: Doc 01 §5.1/§5.3 and overview §4.1 render the format as "<BBhhH>"; the trailing '>' is markdown notation — Python struct rejects it (struct.error: bad char in struct format, verified). Executable snippets (Doc 02 §3, Docs 13/30) use '<BBhhH', which is this file's struct_format.

auth_byte.source: 8-bit XOR checksum of the 16-byte (128-bit) pairing token

byte_layout.name: auth_byte
byte_layout.semantics: 8-bit XOR checksum of the 16-byte pairing token

0x01.name: MOUSE_MOVE
0x01.notes: Relative move; positive X = right, positive Y = down

0x02.name: MOUSE_SCROLL
0x02.notes: Positive = up / right; maps to MOUSEEVENTF_WHEEL/HWHEEL

0x03.name: MOUSE_BUTTON
0x03.notes: button_id 1:L 2:R 3:M; state 1:Down 2:Up 3:Click; Click = synthesized Down+Up (atomic drag-safe)

0x04.name: SCRUB_SEEK
0x04.notes: target = (high << 16) | (low & 0xFFFF); low word is two's-complement bit pattern in int16

golden_vectors.doc_hex_note: Doc 02 §5.4 prints `DD 0E` (= 0x0EDD, 3805); little-endian of the frozen field 3661 (0x0E4D) is `4D 0E`. The worked example's "0x0E2D" (= 3629) and "3621" are misprints too; scenario 1h 01m 01s = 3661 and §9 split/join(3661)==3661 govern.
Doc 02 §5.4 prints `10 11`; low word 0x1170 = 4464 little-endian is `70 11`. Fields + worked example (70000 = 0x11170) govern; corrected here.

notes: auth_byte = 0x5A in vectors G1-G6 is illustrative; the real value derives from the Doc 15 pairing token.
G5/G6 hex values are corrections of transcription typos in Doc 02 §5.4; see each vector's doc_hex_note.
